notes: Fixed the Featured hero's live video preview not actually playing on TV: the native preview player was being told to jump 90 seconds into the stream right at the start, before it knew whether that position was even valid - which could silently stall it on some titles and leave just the still backdrop showing. It now waits until the player confirms the content is a long, seekable video before skipping ahead, so the preview starts reliably and still opens on real footage for movies.
